product.ingredients_text: 74% hydrated vegetable proteins (water, 17% WHEAT PROTEIN, 3% SOYA PROTEIN), rapeseed oil, coconut oil, citrus fibres, flavourings, vinegar, WHEAT FLOUR, thickener (methylcellulose), colour (beetroot red), starch (contains WHEAT), colouring safflower concentrate, spices, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, BARLEY MALT EXTRACT, iron, vitamin B12. May contain oats, egg and milk. 240 g SERVING SUGGESTION
